logp.method_description: Mixture of n-octanol and water (1:1 v/v, 20 mL) was shook for 24 h by a constant temperature oscillator so that the two phases can be saturated with each other. Then, the two-phase distribution was carried out. The Ir1-Ir2 were added to a mixture of 1 mL water-saturated n-octanol and 1 mL n-octanol saturated water to obtain the final concentration of 50 μM. The solution was mixed and then vortexed on a constant temperature oscillator for overnight. After stationary, the two-phases were dispersed in 2 mL ethanol, respectively, and then the complex concentration in each phase was quantified by measuring the absorbance at 465 nm. The calculation formula: Log P = the concentration of complex in n-octanol phase/the concentration of complex in water phase.
